snippet.title: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire - From the Streets Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Start from nothing. Become the boss.
Steaam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2774040/The_Boss_Gangster_Criminal_Empire/

The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire is a unique open-world experience that combines sandbox, tycoon, simulation, RPG and strategy systems into one seamless city.

With the From the Streets update, the game becomes a fully sandbox experience where you choose your own path:

Start as a pickpocket, taxi driver, or small hustler
Build your business from a motel room
Manage your nightclub and staff
Expand into warehouse-scale drug operations
Control your crew and fight rival families
Escape the police or face jail

Every system is connected. Every action has consequences.

🔥 From the Streets Update – May 8
💸 20% Discount on Steam

🎮 Key Features:
Open world sandbox crime experience
Deep nightclub tycoon system
Warehouse & drug production management
Police & wanted system
Multi-character control
Dynamic city with reactive AI
Vehicle damage & destruction system
Side jobs & mini-games

The city is your playground. How you take control is up to you.
👉 Wishlist / Play Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2774040/The_Boss_Gangster_Criminal_Empire/
